doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

chapter: Joe Rene: Lewis, the Rena band and New Orleans
title: George Lewis's mother, red beans, and his name Zeno versus Lewis
summary: Rene recalls cooking red beans at Lewis's house and Lewis staying thin. They discuss why Zeno became Lewis and Rene's own name correction.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Did you ever meet George's mother? George's mother? No, I don't believe I met George's mother. I don't believe I ever met her. I can't remember meeting her. She's an older lady. She's, she died only a few years ago. She was about nearly a hundred, I think she's.

Yeah. I might have been George with the rifle. We supposed to get it plenty, you know. And George, I can't remember, I can't even tell you that, but I seen his mother in life. I might have though.
